source_caption:
🎬 Leading Lady (2014)

Leading Lady follows Jodi Rutherford, an ambitious British actress who dreams of landing a major role in a historical film set in South Africa. Determined to deliver an authentic performance, Jodi travels to the South African countryside to learn more about the culture, lifestyle, and experiences of the woman she hopes to portray. Her journey leads her to a beautiful farm owned by Kobus Willemse, a rugged and independent farmer whose straightforward personality is completely different from the glamorous entertainment world Jodi knows. Initially struggling to adapt to rural life, Jodi encounters unfamiliar responsibilities, unexpected challenges, and amusing misunderstandings that push her far outside her comfort zone. As she spends more time working alongside Kobus and getting to know his family, she begins discovering a simpler and more meaningful way of living. Their contrasting personalities gradually create an unexpected romantic connection, forcing Jodi to question her priorities, relationships, and ambitions. Meanwhile, complications involving her career and personal life threaten the happiness she has begun to find. Through charming encounters, heartfelt conversations, and moments of self-discovery, Jodi realizes that the most important role she may ever play is being herself. Combining beautiful South African scenery, romantic comedy, and uplifting storytelling, Leading Lady explores love, ambition, cultural differences, personal growth, authenticity, and finding happiness in unexpected places.

🎭 Genre: Romance • Comedy • Drama

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 36m

🎥 Director: Henk Pretorius

✍️ Writers: Henk Pretorius & Tina Kruger

source_details.title: Leading Lady
source_details.synopsis: Leading Lady is a 2014 comedy-drama film directed by Henk Pretorius, produced by Llewelynn Greeff, and starring Katie McGrath, Bok van Blerk and Canadian actor Gil Bellows as the film's antagonist, Daniel Taylor, a fictional Hollywood movie director. The film was filmed on location in South Africa and released in 29 November 2014. It is the first feature film that Pretorius and Greeff produced together through their production company, Dark Matter Studios.
